[NDBG.14r.1.1] Replay is entered by the `trace` launch argument
([NDBG.9.3.1]) or by `ds/loadRecording`. The engine is driven from a
recorded fact stream rather than live inputs. Every execution-control
operation works in both modes, except the step granularities [NDBG.14.1.1]
reserves to replay.
